plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Electro-Mechanical Technician Certificate' program map, Catalog 2026-27, published June 3, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7697/PublishedPdf). Official Total Units: 20; this seed = 11 + 9 = 20 units. Semester sums verified against the map's 11 / 9 headers. In-plan prereqs: IMMT 220 and IMMT 230 require IMMT 120, 130, and 140 with grades of 'C' or better; IMMT 240 requires IMMT 120, 130, and 140 with grades of 'C' or better; IMMT 250 requires IMMT 230 with a grade of 'C' or better; IMMT 252 requires IMMT 250 with a grade of 'C' or better. Sequencing note (documented): in Semester 1, IMMT 120, 130, and 140 are taken during the 1st 8-week term and IMMT 220 and 230 during the 2nd 8-week term; in Semester 2, IMMT 240 and 250 during the 1st 8-week term and IMMT 252 during the 2nd 8-week term. Certificate of Achievement requirements: grade of 'C' or better in each major course. Electro-Mechanical Technician, Business & Industry Meta Majors. tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
